_doc: Single source of truth for judgment fields. Hand-edit this; PRIORITIES.md, docs/data.json and the dashboard are generated from it by scripts/sync.py. Percent = toward SHIPPED as defined in projects/<repo>.md. eta_days = focused agent working days for the orchestrator's share, excluding waits on the user. Every estimate the orchestrator commits to goes in `estimates` (date, scope, est_days); when finished, fill done + actual_days. The dashboard computes slip from that ledger.
